name: hnx_rp3a3_sln_b-leafnb-COMMIT
purpose: HNEXT.ATT4 cluster-leaf successor of hnx_rp3a3_spvm_safe_nf (TT/FF pin-flop spread 127/114 on one 18.5k-sink root; GRT killed by the 4 h stall watchdog, rc 137): leaf N = words 0..7 (N face of the parent), 9 SRAMs + 8 adders + an identical control replica, own clock root, every pin registered; floorplan variant B (compact abutted rows). Below release (next-release HBM die P=3).

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_hnx_att4_sleaf_n #(.NL(3)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS -DOT_HNX_ATT_SAFE_RESET -DOT_FP_DATA_NORST --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_prefix.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fastfp.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_add_lat.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_add_lat_fan32.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_add_lat7_fan32_native.v rtl/hbm_next/att/ot_hnx_att4_smerge_h.sv rtl/hbm_next/att/ot_hnx_att4_sleaf.sv physical/hbm_next/att4/macros/hnx_sram_1r1w_128x256_r43/hnx_sram_1r1w_128x256_r43_bb.v && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/hnx_rp3a3_sln_b/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/hnx_rp3a3_sln_b/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/hnx_rp3a3_sln_b --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_hnx_att4_sleaf_n --macro-view physical/hbm_next/att4/macros/hnx_sram_1r1w_128x256_r43 > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run
